spans.s:
n. (-त्रं)
A parasol, an umbrella, the Indian catta.
f. (-त्रा)
1 A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
2 A pungent seed, coriander.
3 A mushroom.
4 Anise.
E.
छद to cover, and ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix; hence the word and its derivatives are also written with a double त, छत्त्र, &c.

m. (-त्रः)
A scholar, a pupil, a disciple, a tyro or novice.
n. (-त्रं)
Honey.
E.
छत्र an umbrella, a screen or cover, affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
A king-fisher.
2 A mushroom.
3 A shrub, commonly Kuliyā-khāra.
4 A small vaulted temple, in honour of a deity.
5 A beehive of a conical or umbrella form.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-कं)
A mushroom.
f. (-की)
A plant, commonly Rāsnā: see रास्ना.
E.
छत्र a parasol, and अक to go, to resemble; affixes अण् and ङीष्.

n. (-कं)
Honey in the comb or hive.
E.
छत्रक a hive, and अण् aff.

n. (-क्रं)
An astrological diagram.
E.
छत्र, and चक्र a circle.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Bearing a parasol, having or possessing one.
E.
छत्र, and धर who has or holds, affix अण्; also छत्रधर, छत्रधारक, and छत्रधारिन्.

n. (-णं)
1 Carrying a catta.
2 The carrying of one as a type of authority.
E.
छत्र, and धारण having.

n. (-त्रं)
A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
छत्र, and पत्र a leaf, umbrella-leaved; also छत्रपत्रक.

Wilfulness, independence.
3 Subversion of dominion, loss of empire, deposition, &c.
E.
छत a parasol, and भङ्ग a breaking; in the first two senses छत्र is used metaphorically, for any cover or defence, as a husband, &c.; in the last it is used by synecdoche, a parasol being one of the ensigns of royalty.

m. (-त्रः)
A fragrant grass, described as growing in marshy ground.
E.
छत्र a mushroom, and अतिछत्र surpassing an umbrella, i. e. more like a catta, than even a mushroom.

f. (-का)
A mushroom.
E.
छत्र, कन् affix of resemblance, fem. form.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
Bearing a parasol or umbrella.
m. (-त्री)
A barber.
E.
छत्र, and इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A house, a dwelling.
2 A bower, an arbour.
E.
छद to cover, स्वरच् Uṇādi affix, and त substituted for द.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cut, divided.
2 Thin, feeble, emaciated.
E.
छो to cut, affix क्त; also छित.

m. (-ण्डः)
An indifferent scholar in poetical composition; one citing imperfect portions only of a verse.

n. (-नं)
Oiled butter prepared from milk one day old.
